# Fixtures

All fixtures are synthetic and generated by `tools/fe_render` (`scripts/make-fixtures.sh`):
point lights, bright window in a dark frame, neon tubes with a thin line, highlight gradient,
colour chart, night street with a skin-tone patch, procedural foliage texture, mid grey.
Generated images go to `tests/fixtures/out/` and are not committed. Real footage tests (portrait,
foliage, film scans) must use media you have the rights to and are not stored in the repository.
